entries.english: Two letters: (1) Friedrich von Rosenberg to Counts Kraft and Albrecht von Hohenlohe, 1568; (2) Moritz, Landgrave of Hesse, to Count Wolfgang von Hohenlohe, 1601. Dates: 1568, 1601. Extent: 2 documents.
